fn active_diagnostic() {
    // #rw(rust_dbg, rust_panic) active debug and stale panic targets
    dbg!(1);
}

fn stale_diagnostic() {
    // #rw(rust_panic) stale panic target
    let value = 1;
    assert_eq!(value, 1, "fixture value must stay stable");
}

const DIRECTIVE_LOOKALIKE: &str = r#"
// #rw(rust_panic) raw string content must not be edited
"#;

// Ordinary comments must remain byte-for-byte intact.
